source.check: returned unopposed: listed by the News-Letter among 'Those returned unopposed' (21 May 1958)

note: Polled 5 June 1958 (Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1958: 'polling will take place on June 5'). Nominations were received on 20 May. Seventeen seats were returned unopposed at nomination. Two contests were nominated, Dungiven and Faughanvale, but polling on 5 June took place only in Dungiven; the Faughanvale poll did not go ahead and John M'Laughlin, who is named as the outgoing member in 1961, was returned (Northern Whig, 6 June 1958, p. 3; Irish News, 6 June 1958, p. 1). The Dungiven result is recorded here. No party labels were printed for the unopposed returns. Returned unopposed.
